summary: Guidewire Software filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a new multi-year agreement, entered September 4, 2026, with a top 10 US-based insurance carrier covering its personal lines book on Guidewire Cloud and PolicyCenter. The deal elevates that customer into Guidewire's top 10 by fully ramped annual recurring revenue. Management stated the transaction requires no revision to quarterly or full-year guidance issued September 3, 2026. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; this is an ordinary commercial customer contract, not a special situation.
